use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use Math = System.Math

let inner = Math.cos(0.4D * Math.pi) / Math.cos(0.2D * Math.pi)

corner(index: int) -> (x: double, y: double) =>
    (let radius = if index % 2 == 0 then 1.0D else inner fi
     let angle = (90.0D + 36.0D * cast double(index)) *
             Math.pi / 180.0D

     (x = radius * Math.cos(angle),
      y = radius * Math.sin(angle)))

let image = IMAGE(500, 500)

image.view(-1.12D, -1.12D, 1.12D, 1.12D)

image.colour(24ub, 28ub, 56ub)
image.fill(
    [(x = -1.2D, y = -1.2D), (x = 1.2D, y = -1.2D),
     (x = 1.2D, y = 1.2D), (x = -1.2D, y = 1.2D)]
)

image.colour(242ub, 198ub, 62ub)
image.fill((0..10) |> map(corner) |> collect_list())

image.colour(148ub, 32ub, 48ub)
image.stroke(3.0D)
image.line(
    (0::5)
        |> map(point => corner(point * 4 % 10))
        |> collect_list()
)

image.write("pentagram.png")

image.show("pentagram.png")
